pulls.title: Fix publish workflow failure caused by stale cached release targets
pulls.author: copilot-swe-agent
pulls.body:
The `Publish New Draft Version` GitHub Action was failing in run `41139832731` because `make releases` consumed a stale cached `.targets.mk` and required a non-existent versioned XML target. This change ensures release target metadata is regenerated per run instead of restored from cache.

- **Root cause addressed**
  - Removed `.targets.mk` from the cache paths in `publish.yml` so generated release dependencies are not persisted across runs.

- **Deterministic target regeneration**
  - Added an explicit pre-build cleanup step to delete `.targets.mk` before invoking `martinthomson/i-d-template` with `make: releases`.

- **Workflow scope**
  - Change is isolated to `.github/workflows/publish.yml`; no draft content or build logic outside the publish pipeline was modified.

```yaml
- name: "Caching"
  uses: actions/cache@v5
  with:
    path: |
      .refcache
      .venv
      .gems
      node_modules

- name: "Reset Generated Make Targets"
  run: rm -f .targets.mk
```

pulls.title: Guard publish tag-annotation fetch to tag refs only
pulls.author: copilot-swe-agent
pulls.body:
The **Publish New Draft Version** workflow was failing on manual dispatch from `main` because it attempted to fetch into the currently checked-out local branch. This change scopes the tag-annotation fetch to tag-triggered runs, preventing the branch-ref conflict while preserving tag publish behavior.

- **Root cause addressed**
  - `Get Tag Annotations` ran unconditionally and executed:
    - `git fetch -f origin ${{ github.ref }}:${{ github.ref }}`
  - On `workflow_dispatch` from `main`, this resolves to `refs/heads/main:refs/heads/main`, which Git rejects when `main` is checked out.

- **Workflow change**
  - Added a tag guard to the fetch step in `.github/workflows/publish.yml`:
    - `if: github.ref_type == 'tag'`
  - Keeps annotation fetch for tag publishes; skips it for branch/manual dispatch runs.

- **Minimal diff**
```yaml
- name: "Get Tag Annotations"
  if: github.ref_type == 'tag'
  run: git fetch -f origin ${{ github.ref }}:${{ github.ref }}
```
